name: Related Skills
headline: PIG 文档搜索: 快速查询官方文档
short_description: Search and extract core information from PIG official documentation. Helps developers and users find answers to PIG-related questions quickly.
author: lltx

sections.overview:
PIG 文档搜索技能帮助开发者和用户快速查询 PIG 官方文档中的信息。该技能支持文档搜索和核心信息提取，使用户能够有效地解决与 PIG 相关的问题。无需手动翻阅冗长文档，该技能提供精准的搜索和智能信息提取，适合需要频繁查阅 PIG 文档的开发者。通过集成到 AI 代理中，该技能可以加速问题排查和开发效率。
用户需要查找关于PIG Cloud的配置文档
用户询问如何解决OAuth2登录失败问题
用户寻找关于网关路由错误的解决方案
The `GROUP ALL` operator in Apache PIG aggregates all tuples in a relation into a single tuple. This is useful for operations like counting total records or calculating global statistics.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/lltx/skills --skill pigdoc`
`git clone https://github.com/lltx/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Search the official Apache PIG documentation and extract the most relevant information about [TOPIC]. Focus on [SPECIFIC_ASPECT], such as syntax, examples, or best practices. Provide clear, concise answers with citations from the documentation. If the topic is broad, break it into subtopics and prioritize [COMPANY]/[INDUSTRY] use cases where applicable.
```
Copy

```
# PIG Documentation Search Results: GROUP ALL Operator

```pig
-- Load data
raw_logs = LOAD 'web_logs' AS (user, url, timestamp);

-- Count total records
log_count = FOREACH (GROUP all_data ALL) GENERATE COUNT($1);
DUMP log_count;
-- Output: (15000)
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
